summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases and graph-unchanged checks. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) using the shared venv's Python. Nothing was committed. mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only; the ignores on bare-IRI operator lines are the most likely point of mismatch with warn_unused_ignores. None and plain-string inputs are guarded explicitly with an isinstance(Node) check to avoid the graph wildcard behavior.
